name: Heart of Disruption
objectiveText: Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran . Arcane Mote  ( 1 )

comments.body: If you speak to her as Alliance before picking up [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=92432/an-alarming-request]An Alarming Request[/url], the breadcrumb quest, she just says Dalaran is closed. You have to pick it up to get the quest. This is for the final days of beta of WoW Forever.
